command: set -euo pipefail; echo '===SYSTEMCTL_CAT==='; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service --no-pager; echo '===DROPINS==='; D=/home/ai-core-node/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service.d; if [ -d "$D" ]; then for f in "$D"/*.conf; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; echo "--- $f"; sha256sum "$f"; sed -n '1,200p' "$f"; done; fi; echo '===EFFECTIVE==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths -p ExecStart -p MainPID -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager
